Planning a whole-house renovation in Delta, British Columbia? In 2026, a comprehensive home renovation in Delta typically costs between $150,000 and $600,000, depending on scope, finishes, and whether you are renovating a single-family home, townhouse, or acreage property. This guide breaks down real 2026 costs using actual 聚星装修 project data from Delta homes.

What Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Delta in 2026?

A whole-house renovation in Delta covers everything from structural updates to finishing work across your entire home. Based on completed 聚星装修 projects in Delta, here is what homeowners can expect to pay in 2026:

  • Minor whole-house updates (2–3 rooms, cosmetic updates): $40,000–$80,000
  • Major partial renovations (kitchen, 2 bathrooms, flooring): $120,000–$250,000
  • Full whole-house renovation (all rooms, structural changes): $250,000–$600,000+
  • Acreage or custom-home renovation: $600,000–$1,500,000+

Delta Kitchen Renovation Costs 2026

The kitchen is the most expensive room to renovate in any Delta home. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Delta costs $45,000–$90,000 in 2026. Premium kitchens with custom cabinetry, stone countertops, and integrated appliances run $90,000–$150,000+.

Key cost factors for Delta kitchens:

  • Cabinetry: $15,000–$60,000 depending on custom vs. pre-fabricated
  • Countertops: $3,000–$15,000 for quartz or granite
  • Appliances: $5,000–$25,000 for a full kitchen suite
  • Electrical and plumbing updates: $3,000–$12,000
  • Flooring: $3,000–$10,000 depending on material choice

Delta Bathroom Renovation Costs 2026

A full bathroom renovation in Delta costs $25,000–$55,000 per bathroom in 2026. A master bath with premium finishes runs higher. A mid-range guest or secondary bathroom renovation typically falls between $18,000 and $35,000.

Whole House Renovation vs. Buying New in Delta

Delta homeowners often face a choice: renovate their existing home or buy a new property. In 2026, the average sale price of a single-family home in Delta remains competitive compared to Vancouver proper, making renovation a strong value proposition.

Key reasons Delta homeowners choose renovation:

  • Preserve land and location: Delta neighbourhoods like Tsawwassen, Ladner, and North Delta offer low-density living that new construction cannot replicate at the same price point
  • Customisation: Renovating lets you adapt the layout to your specific needs rather than accepting a developer's floor plan
  • Faster move-in timeline: A major renovation takes 3–8 months versus 12–18 months for new construction
  • Lower land costs: You keep your existing lot, avoiding Delta's land acquisition costs

What Affects Your Whole House Renovation Cost in Delta?

Every Delta home is different. These factors most significantly impact your total renovation budget:

  • Scope of work: Cosmetic refreshes cost a fraction of structural renovations
  • Age of home: Heritage homes in Delta may require updated electrical, plumbing, and structural work
  • Finish level: Standard finishes cost 40–60% less than premium custom finishes
  • Permits: Delta requires building permits for structural changes; budget $3,000–$15,000 for permit fees
  • Site conditions: Homes with challenging access or asbestos remediation needs will cost more

How Long Does a Whole House Renovation Take in Delta?

Project timelines for whole-house renovations in Delta:

  • Minor updates: 6–12 weeks
  • Major partial renovation: 3–5 months
  • Full whole-house renovation: 6–12 months
  • Acreage or structural-heavy projects: 12–18 months

2026年，三角洲（Delta）整屋装修的典型费用在15万至60万加元之间，具体取决于工程范围、装修档次以及房屋类型（独立屋、联排别墅或庄园物业）。本文基于聚星装修在三角洲完成的真实工程项目，为您详细解析2026年各项装修成本。

2026年三角洲整屋装修多少钱？

三角洲整屋装修涵盖从结构改造到全屋精装的各个层面。根据聚星装修在三角洲完成的工程项目，2026年房主可参考的费用区间如下：

  • 轻度整屋更新（2–3个房间，装饰性翻新）：4万–8万加元
  • 重大局部翻新（厨房、2个卫生间、地板）：12万–25万加元
  • 全套整屋翻新（所有房间，结构改造）：25万–60万加元以上
  • 庄园或定制住宅翻新：60万–150万加元以上

聚星装修已在三角洲完成多个整屋翻新项目，包括一套配备高级装修的厨房及两间卫生间的全面翻新。

三角洲厨房翻新费用 2026

厨房是三角洲任何住宅中翻新费用最高的区域。2026年，中档厨房翻新费用为4.5万–9万加元。配备定制橱柜、石材台面和集成电器的豪华厨房则高达9万–15万加元以上。

三角洲卫生间翻新费用 2026

2026年，三角洲全卫生间翻新每间费用为2.5万–5.5万加元。配备高级设施的主人浴室费用更高。客房或次卫的中档翻新通常在1.8万–3.5万加元之间。

三角洲整屋翻新是否需要申请建筑许可？

需要。三角洲镇（Corporation of Delta）要求对结构改造、电气升级、管道修改及任何改变房屋占地面积或结构完整性的工程申请建筑许可。根据工程范围，许可费用预算为3,000–15,000加元。聚星装修提供许可申请的全流程服务。

是的。聚星装修已在三角洲所有社区完成翻新工程项目，包括措瓦森、拉德纳和北三角洲。公司为整个三角洲地区的房主提供免费、无义务的报价服务。
